categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies assumeutxo snapshot deserialization in `src/node/utxo_snapshot.h` and adds test coverage in `src/test/validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled `std::bad_optional_access` exception when constructing the error message during assumeutxo snapshot loading on a custom signet with mismatched network magic. This is a worthwhile bug fix for assumeutxo error reporting, though confined to an edge case.
